description: Na₂SrSi₂O₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.78 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with eight NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.80 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SrO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.90 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.70 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded to six O atoms to form SrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.45 Å) and four longer (2.47 Å) Sr-O bond lengths. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded to eight O atoms to form SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SrO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one SrO₆ octahedra, corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramid, and edges with four NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one SrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent SrO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with three NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Sr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Sr, and one Si atom.
